purpose: Judges every commit in a range by the stage prefix on its subject (DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW:, TEST:, FINALISE:) against the file classes that stage owns, deriving the role from the stage, so the separation of duties is one marker a reader sees in git log.
responsibilities: parse the strict stage prefix on every commit subject, merges included, and derive the role (DEFINE test-author, BUILD builder, REVIEW reviewer, TEST verifier, FINALISE stage-keeper)
class every touched path and judge it against the stage's owned classes (neutral applies to DEFINE and BUILD only)
judge a merge commit by the paths its resolution changed (combined diff), under the merge subject's stage
accept a FINALISE: declared-generator output only when the commit names the generator in a Generated-By: trailer and rcf/separation.json declares it
during the transition, read a Hand: trailer only to check it agrees with the derived role; Hand: mixed fails
read files only through git at commits in the range; never write, never spawn anything but git, never touch the network

interfaces.name: rcf audit separation
interfaces.description:
usage: rcf audit separation [--base <ref>] [--head <ref>] [--json]
Range: merge-base with origin/main (or --base) to HEAD (or --head), merges included. PASS line: "separation: PASS <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): DEFINE <n>, BUILD <n>, REVIEW <n>, TEST <n>, FINALISE <n>, merges <n>, transition <n>" (merges and transition also count inside their stage). FAIL line: "separation: FAIL <k> of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <item>[; <item>...]" with items "<sha7> no stage prefix", "<sha7> malformed stage prefix \"<first token>\"; use DEFINE:, BUILD:, REVIEW:, TEST: or FINALISE:", "<sha7> <STAGE>: touches <path> (class <class>, owned by <STAGE list>)", "<sha7> FINALISE: changes package.json beyond its \"version\" line (class production, owned by BUILD)", "<sha7> FINALISE: merge resolution touches <path> (class <class>); a merge that needs a code fix goes back to BUILD in a new round", "<sha7> Hand: <value> disagrees with <STAGE>: (role <role>)", "<sha7> Hand: mixed is retired; commit chores as FINALISE: within its file classes", "<sha7> Generated-By: <id> is not declared in rcf/separation.json". Exit 0 PASS, 4 FAIL, 2 usage (bad ref "separation: bad ref <ref>", shallow "separation: shallow repository, the history from <ref> is missing (fetch with full depth)", malformed config "separation: malformed rcf/separation.json: <detail>", retired flag "[error] usage --require-hand is retired; every commit needs a stage prefix"), 1 "separation: not a git repository".

interfaces.name: SeparationRow v2
interfaces.description: fields: sha (40 hex), subject, merge (boolean), stage (DEFINE | BUILD | REVIEW | TEST | FINALISE | null), role (test-author | builder | reviewer | verifier | stage-keeper | null), handTrailer (string | null), classes (array of class names touched), generators (array of Generated-By ids), verdict (pass | fail), reason (string, empty on pass), paths (array; for a merge, the combined-diff paths). --json prints an array with one row per commit in range order.

interfaces.name: Default path classes and owners
interfaces.description: fields: criteria (rcf/ except the paths below; DEFINE), rcfTest (test/, tests/, __tests__/, e2e/ directories and *.test.* / *.spec.* files, at any depth, except hygieneTest; DEFINE), hygieneTest (a hygiene/ directory directly under test/, tests/ or __tests__/ at any depth, and *.hygiene.test.* files; BUILD), production (everything else, and rcf/code-nodes/; BUILD), reviewVerdict (rcf/verdicts/<h12>/review.json; REVIEW), testVerdict (rcf/verdicts/<h12>/test.json and test-strength.json; TEST), verifierEvidence (rcf/verify-reports/ except releases/; TEST), releaseEvidence (rcf/verify-reports/releases/; FINALISE), chainStatus (rcf/fbs/; DEFINE and FINALISE), release (CHANGELOG*, RELEASE*, releases/releases.yaml; BUILD and FINALISE), versionField (package.json when its diff touches only the "version" line; FINALISE), lockfile (the 0.36.1 lockfile set; DEFINE, BUILD and FINALISE), neutral (rcf/manifest.json, Markdown outside rcf/, .github/; DEFINE and BUILD), generatorOutput (a declared output named by Generated-By:; FINALISE). REVIEW and TEST own only their verdict and evidence classes.

interfaces.name: rcf/separation.json v2
interfaces.description: format: JSON, read from the head commit through git. { "classes": { <class>: [glob, ...] }, "generators": [ { "id": <kebab id>, "command": <shell text>, "outputs": [glob, ...] (one or more), "checkedBy": <repo-relative test file that compares the output with fresh output; must exist at head> } ] }. 0.36.x class names test, criteria, production, verifierEvidence, stageKeeper and neutral are read as rcfTest, criteria, production, verifierEvidence, release and neutral with one "[warn] separation: class <old> is read as <new>" line on stderr. The file itself classes criteria. Malformed JSON, an unknown class, a generator without id, command, a non-empty outputs list or checkedBy, or a checkedBy path missing at head: exit 2 naming generators[<i>].<field> or the class.

notes: Replaces the Hand-trailer judgement of TAC-4149 (src/audit/separation.js:13-24 HANDS and OWNED, :103-129 classifyPath, :143-187 judgeCommit, :264-267 the trailer read, :273-274 merges skipped). Round order (monotonic stages, failed-verdict regression) is the rounds slice, judged by the same verb.
name: rcf audit separation by stage prefix: per-stage file classes, hygiene tests, declared generators, merges and the transition
